Keep entities as short noun phrases. Extract every fact stated in the text, including side effects, conditions, interactions, dosing, warnings and patient instructions (use relationships like "has administration instruction", "has missed dose instruction", "has overdose instruction", "has storage instruction" for advice sentences). Output a JSON list of triples.

Text: Lipitor (atorvastatin) belongs to a group of drugs called statins. Lipitor is used together with diet to lower blood levels of "bad" cholesterol (LDL) and to reduce the risk of stroke and heart attack. It works by blocking an enzyme the body needs to make cholesterol.
